40723198.title: Experto en Automatización, IA y n8n Requerido
40723198.description: Busco un freelance especializado en automatización, IA y n8n para desarrollar y mantener un sistema para una clínica dental en Madrid. IMPORTANTE: NO necesitamos crear una web nueva. La clínica ya dispone de web. El trabajo consiste principalmente en automatización, integración de herramientas, WhatsApp, base de datos y marketing digital. OBJETIVO Crear un sistema centralizado que permita a la clínica captar, atender y reactivar pacientes automáticamente, reduciendo el trabajo manual de recepción. TRABAJO INICIAL 1. WhatsApp + IA * Integración con WhatsApp Business API. * Automatizaciones mediante n8n. * Respuestas automáticas. * Clasificación de pacientes. * Derivación a recepción cuando sea necesario. * Posibilidad de conectar agenda/citas. 2. Base de datos * La clínica dispone de aproximadamente 14.000 pacientes. * Limpieza y segmentación de la base. * Segmentación por pacientes activos/inactivos/tratamientos. * Preparación para campañas de reactivación. 3. Email + WhatsApp * Crear automatizaciones para campañas de reactivación. * Recordatorios y seguimiento. * Diferentes flujos según el tipo de paciente. 4. IA * Integración con Claude u otro modelo adecuado. * Automatización de tareas repetitivas. * Clasificación y gestión de conversaciones. * Posibilidad de utilizar voz/transcripción si técnicamente tiene sentido. 5. Google Ads * Configuración técnica. * Conversiones y tracking. * Integración con la web existente. * Preparación de campañas. * Automatización de leads cuando sea posible. 6. Instagram / Meta * Automatización de procesos relacionados con leads y mensajes. * Integraciones mediante API cuando sea necesario. 7. Reputación * Sistema de monitorización de reseñas. * Automatización de avisos y seguimiento. HERRAMIENTAS Preferiblemente experiencia con: * n8n * WhatsApp Business API * Meta API * Claude / OpenAI * Google APIs * Google Ads * CRM * APIs y webhooks * PostgreSQL / Supabase si es necesario * Email marketing * Automatización de procesos IMPORTANTE No buscamos solamente alguien que haga un chatbot. Buscamos una persona que pueda diseñar la arquitectura, desarrollar las automatizaciones, integrarlas y dejarlas funcionando en producción. El proyecto se desarrollará por fases y con hitos. FORMA DE TRABAJO Nosotros somos una agencia de IA y automatización en España y somos quienes gestionamos al cliente final. El freelance trabajará como colaborador técnico de nuestra agencia. Queremos una relación a largo plazo para futuros proyectos de clientes. PARA PRESENTAR TU PROPUESTA Indica: 1. Tu experiencia con n8n. 2. Proyectos realizados con WhatsApp + IA. 3. Si has trabajado con clínicas, salud o bases de datos grandes. 4. Qué herramientas utilizarías para este proyecto. 5. Tiempo estimado. 6. Precio para la implementación inicial. 7. Precio mensual de mantenimiento. 8. Portfolio o ejemplos reales. No envíes una propuesta genérica. Queremos ver ejemplos concretos de automatizaciones que hayas desarrollado.
40723198.decision: Проект не подходит по нескольким правилам: во-первых, требуется настройка рекламы Google Ads и веб-трекинга (рекламой и маркетингом мы не занимаемся); во-вторых, клиент ищет специалиста именно по n8n, в то время как мы пишем автоматизации исключительно на Python.

40722139.title: AI Workflow Automation Setup
40722139.description: I run a small services company and would like our routine workflows to run themselves. The core stack is Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and HubSpot; I need an expert who can connect those three tools to an LLM layer—whether that ends up being ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or a mix—so that data flows automatically and triggers happen without anyone touching a keyboard. Here’s what has to happen. • Data entry & updates: whenever a quote, lead, or status change appears in HubSpot, the relevant rows in Google Sheets should populate or refresh. • Scheduling & reminders: new jobs or follow-ups added in Sheets or HubSpot must instantly create the right Google Calendar events, complete with reminder logic that can adjust if details shift. • AI reasoning: the large-language-model layer should watch these events, interpret notes or plain-language prompts, and decide which workflow to fire—saving summaries, flagging anomalies, or nudging the team when human input is required. I’ll map out the existing process and share API keys; you translate that into stable, maintainable automations. I’m happy with low-code services (Zapier, Make/Integromat, n8n) as long as the solution is transparent and can be handed off cleanly. Acceptance criteria 1. All three platforms stay in sync in real time. 2. No duplicate or dropped records during a two-week live test. 3. Clear hand-off documentation covering triggers, endpoints, and how to swap one LLM provider for another. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s talk about timelines and get it launched.
40722139.decision: Проект полностью соответствует услуге «ИИ-агент / чат-бот на базе Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq» ($350, 21 день). Ниша халяльная (сервисная компания). Клиент пишет, что «будет рад» low-code инструментам, но не требует их жестко, поэтому мы можем честно предложить решение на Python. Все правила профиля и шариата соблюдены.
40722139.proposal: I can build a custom Python-based AI agent that connects HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Google Calendar via their APIs. While you mentioned low-code tools like Zapier or n8n, I specialize in custom Python scripts; this approach is highly transparent, saves you from paying monthly platform subscription fees, and is easy to maintain. The LLM layer (GPT, Claude, or Groq) will interpret your plain-language prompts and notes to dynamically trigger workflows, generate summaries, and flag anomalies. I will also provide clear hand-off documentation so you can easily swap LLM providers or adjust the prompt logic in the future. Could you share how many distinct workflow triggers you currently have mapped out? Also, do you already have developer accounts and API access set up for HubSpot and Google Workspace?

40717879.title: AI Social Media Auto Content Creation & Posting
40717879.description: I want to elevate my brand’s visibility by running an always-on social media presence powered by auto AI smart automation and high-quality creative & posting for all social media plateforms. The core objective is clear: increase brand awareness across Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, and LinkedIn. Here’s the scope. First, a channel-specific strategy that maps audiences, voice and optimal posting cadence. I expect AI tools such as ChatGPT or Jasper for copy ideation, n8n,gemini,Canva, Adobe CC or Midjourney for visuals, and a scheduler like Hootsuite, Buffer or Later to automate publishing. If Zapier or similar workflows can streamline reporting and cross-posting, all the better. Deliverables • Strategy blueprint (PDF or Slides) outlining goals, personas, content pillars and KPIs • Automated scheduling setup, including hashtag libraries and optimal post-time settings • Performance dashboard template pulling basic metrics (reach, impressions, engagement) into one view Acceptance criteria: all assets must be brand-consistent, sized correctly for each platform, scheduled at least one week ahead, and supported by a brief rationale tying each post back to the overall awareness goal. Once everything is live, I’ll review the first performance report; tweaks can follow based on data. Let’s build a fully automated, memorable social footprint from day one.
40717879.decision: Проект включает разработку SMM-стратегии, дизайн в Canva/Adobe CC и создание шаблонов отчетов, что относится к дизайну и SMM (эти услуги я не оказываю). Также клиент запрашивает интеграцию через n8n/Zapier/Buffer вместо разработки на Python.

40712188.title: AI Automation & AI Clone Engineer
40712188.description: AI Automation & AI Clone Engineer OpenAI • OpenClaw • Hermes • n8n • AI Agents • Voice & Video Cloning Long-Term / Full-Time Opportunity | $1,250–$2,000+ USD/Month + Bonuses We are looking for an exceptional AI builder for a long-term position with our AI automation company. If you're the person who sees a business process and immediately starts thinking about how AI could automate 80% of it, keep reading. We have automation projects waiting. And we're building significantly more. We have enough

40716866.title: Automate Harvest Invoice Creation
40716866.description: I need an automation specialist to recreate Harvest invoices in FreeAgent using Zapier or Make.com. The workflow must create in FreeAgent an invoice once I send one to a client via Harvest. To my understanding it's possible to do that but the invoice created in FreeAgent will be a draft. I need to move each FreeAgent invoice from Draft to Sent/Open without re-emailing the client, so invoices do not need to be raised twice for client billing and accounting reconciliation. This is an ongoing automation that runs once a month for around 20 invoices per month. I need a sensible estimated monthly cost to run it. Relevant experience includes Webhooks by Zapier or Make.com's Custom API Request module, FreeAgent API OAuth and invoice transition endpoints, and Harvest integrations. In your proposal, recommend Zapier or Make.com for this API request and explain why. Include examples of similar custom API workflows you have built. WORKFLOW REQUIREMENTS Trigger on new or submitted invoices in Harvest. Create a FreeAgent draft invoice with mapped contact information, line items, amounts, and tax rates. I am happy to manually create clients and tasks if needed in FreeAgent. Match each Harvest client to an existing FreeAgent contact ID, or create a contact when none exists. Use a secondary HTTP/API request to transition the invoice from Draft to Sent without sending an email. Test partial payments, multiple line items, and discounts. Provide a brief handover covering management of the API connection. IMPORTANT FreeAgent's native integration modules create Draft invoices only. The workflow must use the FreeAgent API transition endpoint to mark an invoice as sent silently: PUT https://api.freeagent.com/v2/invoices/:id/transitions/mark_as_sent. Please ensure before applying: - You will need to check that the above workflow is correct, because I generated it with AI. - Check that the work can be done - it is also possible that FreeAgent API wont allow for it - Provide estimate of your cost and of any ongoing cost I might need to pay for the automation - Not an urgent work
40716866.decision: Запрос требует настройки интеграции между Harvest и FreeAgent через Zapier или Make.com. Во-первых, я работаю исключительно на Python (no-code платформы не поддерживаю, если они принципиальны клиенту). Во-вторых, интеграция платежных/бухгалтерских систем и CRM отсутствует в моем жестком списке разрешенных услуг («Что я делаю»).

40725349.title: Automate Internal Operations
40725349.description: We are a refrigerated freight brokerage looking for an experienced automation developer to integrate Tai TMS with Zapier, Microsoft 365/Outlook, and AI. The goal is to automate our email-based appointment scheduling process while keeping dispatchers in control of routing and logistical decisions. Tai will remain the primary operating interface. **Project Deliverables:** * Integrate Tai TMS with Zapier and Microsoft 365/Outlook * Trigger appointment requests based on dispatcher-entered appointment times in Tai * Automatically send and monitor appointment-request emails * Use AI to interpret receiver responses, appointment times, and confirmation numbers * Automatically handle responses within predefined scheduling tolerances * Route exceptions back to dispatchers for human decisions * Write confirmed appointments and confirmation numbers back to the correct stop in Tai * Support multi-stop appointment workflows * Prevent duplicate requests and maintain basic workflow/error logging * Test, document, and hand off the completed automation **Phase 1 Acceptance Criteria:** Phase 1 will be considered complete when the system can successfully demonstrate an end-to-end appointment workflow on test shipments: * Dispatcher enters a requested appointment time for a specific stop in Tai * Automation correctly identifies the shipment and specific stop * Appointment request is automatically sent through Microsoft 365/Outlook with the correct shipment information * Receiver email response is automatically matched to the correct shipment and stop * AI accurately extracts the appointment date/time and confirmation number when provided * Appointment offers within ±60 minutes of the dispatcher-requested time can be handled automatically * Offers outside the ±60-minute tolerance are routed to the dispatcher for approval rather than automatically accepted * Ambiguous, missing, or unrecognized responses are escalated for human review * Confirmed appointment time and confirmation/reference information are written back to the correct Tai shipment/stop * Multi-stop shipments can progress through the appointment workflow without confusing stops or email threads * Duplicate appointment requests and duplicate processing are prevented * Failed automations are logged and surfaced rather than silently failing * The completed workflow is tested successfully using representative multi-stop refrigerated shipments * All Zapier workflows, integrations, documentation, and configuration are handed over to us with full ownership and administrative access The system should be designed so it can later expand into additional freight automation, including after-hours operations and payment/lumper workflows. Experience with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Microsoft 365, AI automation, and system integrations is preferred. Transportation/logistics or TMS experience is a plus. **To Apply:** Please provide a brief description of how you would approach the integration, examples of similar API/Zapier/Microsoft 365 automation projects you have completed, your estimated timeline, and a fixed-price quote for Phase 1. Please begin your application with **“TAI AUTOMATION”** so we know you have reviewed the project requirements. We are interested in establishing an ongoing relationship with the right developer for additional automation projects after Phase 1 is successfully completed.
40725349.decision: Заказчик жестко требует реализацию именно на Zapier и передачу готовых Zapier-воркфлоу в качестве ключевого результата проекта. По правилам профиля, если клиенту принципиально нужен именно Zapier, мы отказываемся, так как пишем решения исключительно на Python.

40719849.title: E-Commerce Workflow Automation Setup
40719849.description: I run a growing e-commerce business and I’m finally ready to replace the patchwork of manual tasks slowing us down. The objective is simple: design and deploy an end-to-end automation system that keeps the store humming with as little hands-on intervention as possible. We’ll start with a discovery call so you can map my current tech stack and pain points. Customer service, inventory management, and marketing are all on the table; I’ll explain the exact priorities during that session. Whether the answer involves Shopify flow triggers, WooCommerce hooks, Magento APIs, or third-party connectors like Zapier, Make, Klaviyo, Gorgias, ShipStation, or Zendesk, I’m open to the most reliable, scalable path. Once we agree on the roadmap, I expect: • A clear architecture diagram and tool list • Configuration and integration of all chosen apps/services • Automated workflows fully tested in a staging environment • A short video or written SOP that shows my team how to monitor and tweak the automations I’ll sign off when each workflow fires correctly under real-world conditions and the documentation proves anyone on my team can maintain it. If this sounds like a challenge you’re excited to tackle, let’s talk details and get the build underway.
40719849.decision: Запрос содержит автоматизацию e-commerce через сторонние коннекторы (Zapier, Make, Klaviyo, Zendesk) и платформы (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento), что не входит в список моих услуг (я делаю только Telegram-ботов, автопостинг, ИИ-генерацию контента, парсеры и ИИ-агентов на Python). Также клиент требует начать с созвона и рассматривает Zapier/Make, с которыми я не работаю.

40717759.title: AI-Driven Marketing Automation Bot
40717759.description: I am building an AI-powered bot devoted to digital marketing and want an expert who can take it from concept to reliable daily use. The bot must learn our brand voice, schedule and optimise Facebook, Instagram and YouTube posts, run behavioural email sequences automatically, and continuously fine-tune on-page SEO. Here is what I need delivered: • Social Media Automation – the bot should draft, A/B test and publish content on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube, pulling performance metrics back into its model for ongoing improvement. • Email Marketing Automation – set up intelligent campaigns that segment users, personalise subject lines and content, and trigger follow-ups based on real-time engagement. • SEO Optimisation – integrate keyword discovery, content gap analysis and meta-tag tuning, then push recommendations straight into our CMS. Acceptance will be based on: 1. A live demo of the bot handling a full weekly content cycle across the three platforms. 2. An automated email flow that adapts subject lines after at least two iterations. 3. A before-and-after SEO report showing measurable improvements in page speed, meta relevance and keyword ranking. Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, GPT-based text generation, Zapier/Make or similar for workflow orchestration, plus experience with Meta and YouTube APIs are all welcome skills if you have them—the goal is a single, self-learning system that reduces manual effort and steadily improves our reach and conversion rates.
40717759.decision: Заказ включает в себя задачи по SEO-оптимизации и улучшению скорости загрузки страниц, что прямо относится к категории услуг, которые я не оказываю согласно профилю (раздел «Чего я не делаю: SEO»).

40712061.title: AI Agent for On-Page SEO
40712061.description: I want an AI-driven workflow that completely handles on-page SEO for my blog posts. The agent should: • Analyse each new draft, run keyword research, and weave primary and secondary terms naturally into the copy without hurting readability. • Generate or refine the post itself when gaps are detected, keeping tone and style consistent with my existing articles. • Produce fully optimised meta titles, meta descriptions, and alt text that stay within character limits and follow current best practices. Ideally the system runs from a single trigger—new draft uploaded to Google Docs or a CMS—and then returns the optimised version plus the meta data in a neat report or directly updates the post. I’m open to whatever stack you prefer (Python, Node, Zapier, Make, OpenAI APIs, LangChain, etc.) as long as it is reliable and easy for me to extend later. Acceptance criteria • End-to-end demo on one of my live blog posts. • Clear installation / setup instructions. • Source code or workflow diagram handed over on completion. If this sounds straightforward to you, let’s discuss the best approach and timeline.
40712061.decision: Проект напрямую связан с SEO (поисковой оптимизацией), в то время как в моем профиле в разделе «Чего я не делаю» прямо указано ограничение на любые задачи, связанные с SEO.

40726060.title: Automated Ticket Buying Desktop App
40726060.description: I’m seeking an experienced developer to complete an existing automated ticket-buying bot with a Windows desktop dashboard for Ticketmaster and SeatGeek. The developer must have already done numerous projects related to this and is skilled at anti-bot resilience. Such as fingerprint spoofing, residential proxy rotation, and CAPTCHA solving hooks. You must have extensive experience bypassing strict anti-bot protections such as, (DataDome, Cloudflare, Akamai). The main deliverable is a working purchasing engine that automatically monitors ticket availability, identifies tickets matching my criteria, reserves them, and completes checkout using assigned accounts and supported saved payment methods. The dashboard must let me configure and monitor this automation without editing code. Source files, executables, screenshots, and an improved dashboard with simulated workflows are available. The existing simulation does not fulfill the automatic purchasing requirement. Automatic Purchasing Requirements Once I configure and start a task, the bot should automatically: 1. Open the specified event using the assigned account sessions. 2. Handle supported queue workflows and begin monitoring when access becomes available. 3. Identify inventory matching my section, row, ticket-type, quantity, seating, and price requirements. 4. Reserve qualifying tickets. 5. Verify the selected tickets, final quantity, and total price, including applicable fees and taxes. 6. Complete checkout through a supported, authorized integration using the assigned purchasing profile and payment method. 7. Verify the order outcome and record the confirmation details. 8. Notify me of successful purchases, failures, or required intervention. 9. Stop when the shared ticket target or spending limit is reached. Provide two selectable operating modes: - Automatic Purchase: Starting the task authorizes purchases within its configured event, ticket criteria, quantity, and spending limits. No additional approval is required for each qualifying purchase. - Approval Required: Reserve qualifying tickets and request approval locally or through Discord before completing checkout. Any authentication, verification, or payment step that requires human involvement must be clearly identified before development. The bot must pause and notify me when intervention is required. Multiple Accounts and Purchase Controls A single task must support multiple accounts and individual purchasing profiles, with an initial configuration target of 50 accounts. This will be more. Coordinate activity across accounts so the bot does not purchase duplicate inventory or exceed shared limits. An individual account failure should not stop other eligible accounts. After a timeout or uncertain checkout response, verify whether an order succeeded before retrying. Once the task target is reached, stop outstanding purchase attempts safely. Required Live Demonstration Demonstrate the complete automatic workflow separately on each supported platform: matching inventory, reservation, final-price validation, checkout submission, and verified order confirmation. Use an agreed test environment or an explicitly authorized live purchase with a fixed spending limit. Clearly identify unsupported features and unavoidable manual steps. A simulation, cart-only demonstration, or checkout link does not satisfy the automatic purchasing requirement. Deliver and demonstrate the agreed live purchasing workflow on Ticketmaster and SeatGeek, including automatic checkout, verified order outcomes, coordinated account activity, enforced quantity/spending limits, duplicate prevention, and notifications. Acceptance requires evidence of the agreed end-to-end functionality on each platform.
40726060.decision: Проект отклонен по нескольким причинам согласно правилам профиля: 1) Требуется разработка десктопного интерфейса (Windows desktop dashboard), что выходит за рамки моих услуг. 2) Требуется обход систем защиты и блокировок платформ (DataDome, Cloudflare, Akamai, fingerprint spoofing, proxy rotation), что прямо запрещено правилами («обход блокировок платформ — это обман, харам»). 3) Требуется работа с фермой аккаунтов (от 50 штук), что также относится к запрещенным категориям («фермы ботов»).

40725827.title: Logistics Google Sheet Automation
40725827.description: I need a comprehensive Google Sheet to manage our logistics operations effectively. This sheet will help me track daily vehicle entries, expenses, and provide various reports. Key Features: - Daily vehicle entry - Driver name and client name - Daily expenses and mileage - Driver salary - Reports: - Daily vehicle utilization - Client invoices - Profit and Loss (PNL) reports (daily, weekly, monthly) Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in Google Sheets - Experience in logistics management - Strong analytical skills for generating reports - Attention to detail and accuracy Looking for a freelancer who can create an organized and user-friendly sheet to streamline our logistics operations.
40725827.decision: Запрос требует создания и настройки комплексной Google Таблицы для логистики (формулы, учет поездок, расходов, генерация PNL-отчетов). Я занимаюсь исключительно разработкой автоматизаций на Python (боты, парсеры, автопостинг, ИИ-интеграции). Проектирование таблиц и ведение учета в них не входит в список моих услуг.

40727022.title: Develop AI Email Outreach Agent
40727022.description: The Goal: I am looking for an AI Automation Specialist to build a multi-agent system that automates my B2B lead generation and email drafting. We are an eventing/hire company based in South Africa. For Phase 1, I need a "human-in-the-loop" system that scrapes targeted local business contacts, researches their recent activity, and drafts highly personalized outreach emails into a Google Sheet or Drafts folder for my review.The Workflow You Will Build:Sourcing & Scraping: Target specific industries in Gauteng, South Africa (Event coordinators, Caterers, Furniture rental companies, Marketing Professionals/PAs). You will need to implement a scraper or use APIs (Apollo, Custom Search, Tavily) to find these leads.Context Gathering: The agent must briefly scan the prospect’s website or public presence to extract one personalized detail (e.g., a recent event they hosted, core service).Drafting (LLM Integration): Use an LLM (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, or Gemini Pro) to write a short, conversational B2B email. The prompt will introduce our company (20 years in business), mention the personalized detail, and ask if they need assistance with upcoming year-end functions.Output (Human-in-the-Loop): Do NOT send the emails. The final output must be logged into a Google Sheet (via API) or Gmail Drafts folder containing: Contact Name, Email, Company, Personalization Context, and the Drafted Email. Preferred Tech Stack:Language: Python Framework: CrewAI, LangGraph, or AutoGen LLM: Open to your recommendation, but prefer Claude 3.5 Sonnet or GPT-4o for drafting.Automation: Open to using n8n or Make.com if it simplifies the Google Sheets/Gmail integration.Future Scope (Phase 2):If Phase 1 is successful, the contract will be extended to build out automated sending, follow-up sequences, and additional agents for competitor analysis on social media.When applying, please answer the following:Have you built an AI scraping and outreach agent before? If so, please link a case study, GitHub repo, or quick Loom video showing it working.What tool or API will you use to bypass scraping blockers for finding B2B leads?Which framework (CrewAI, LangGraph, or other) would you recommend for this specific flow and why?
40727022.decision:
Проект отклонен по следующим причинам:
1. Холодные рассылки (B2B outreach) относятся к категории спам-рассылок, что является харамом и запрещено правилами профиля.
2. Заказчик требует использовать методы обхода блокировок платформ для парсинга («bypass scraping blockers»), что прямо запрещено в разделе «Чего я не делаю».

40717261.title: Unitree R1 Edu embodied AI
40717261.description: Task: Replace Existing Onboard LLM with Local GPT-2B Hardware * Unitree R1 EDU * Onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX / onboard GPU compute platform (~100 TOPS) * Existing robot software and motor-control system are already working. * The robot currently has a built-in Chinese AI chatbot / LLM. The exact model is not yet confirmed and is not Qwen. Main Objective Replace the robot’s existing onboard LLM/chatbot with a local GPT-2B-class language model running directly on the robot’s onboard GPU. The new local model must perform the same high-level conversational / command-understanding function as the existing chatbot, while the existing robot control and motor-control system must remain unchanged. In other words: Existing system: User Voice/Text → Existing Chinese LLM → Existing Robot Control Interface → Motors Target system: User Voice/Text → Local GPT-2B → Existing Robot Control Interface → Motors The GPT-2B model should effectively replace the existing LLM layer, not the robot’s control layer. What the freelancer needs to do 1. Identify the current AI/LLM architecture * Determine what model currently powers the onboard Chinese chatbot. * Identify how the current LLM communicates with the robot’s existing control system. * Identify the existing API, SDK, ROS interface, middleware, or function-calling mechanism used between the LLM and robot control. 2. Deploy a local GPT-2B model * Select an appropriate ~2B parameter model suitable for local inference. * Deploy it on the robot’s onboard NVIDIA GPU. * Use GPU-accelerated inference (TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp CUDA, vLLM, or another appropriate optimized runtime). * Optimize the model for low latency and reasonable memory/compute usage. 3. Connect GPT-2B to the existing robot interface * Do NOT rewrite the existing motor-control system. * Do NOT develop new low-level motor drivers. * Do NOT replace the existing Unitree SDK / motion-control implementation. * Instead, make the new LLM communicate with the existing high-level robot-control interface in the same way the current chatbot does. 4. Function / command calling The local GPT-2B should be able to interpret natural-language commands and generate structured commands/functions that are already supported by the robot. For example: "Stand up and walk forward" → GPT-2B interprets intent → calls existing robot functions such as: stand() walk_forward() The exact available functions/interfaces should be determined from the existing R1 EDU software. 5. Voice interface If the existing system already provides speech recognition, preserve it. If necessary, the architecture should support: Microphone → Local STT → GPT-2B → Existing Robot Functions The primary task is LLM replacement, not development of a new speech-recognition system. Important constraint The freelancer must reuse the existing robot-control stack. The project is NOT: * rewriting robot locomotion * rewriting motor control * developing a new Unitree SDK layer * developing a new walking controller * developing a new ROS control architecture The project IS: Replacing the existing onboard Chinese LLM with a locally running GPT-2B model and connecting the new model to the existing robot-control interface. Expected final architecture Microphone / Text Input ↓ Existing or Local STT ↓ Local GPT-2B running on onboard NVIDIA GPU ↓ Structured command / function call ↓ Existing R1 EDU Robot API / ROS / SDK ↓ Existing Motion & Motor Control ↓ Robot Deliverables 1. Local GPT-2B model running on R1 EDU onboard computer. 2. GPU-accelerated inference. 3. Integration with the existing robot-control interface. 4. Natural-language command → structured robot function execution. 5. Source code for the integration layer. 6. Installation/deployment instructions. 7. Ability to run the system autonomously on the robot without cloud LLM/API dependency. 8. Basic demonstration showing that the new GPT-2B successfully replaces the existing chatbot while the existing robot-control system continues to operate un
40717261.decision: Запрос относится к сфере робототехники (Embodied AI), требует интеграции с ROS/ROS2, работы с платой NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX и низкоуровневым кодом управления роботом Unitree R1. Я делаю целевые автоматизации (боты, парсеры, генерация контента), а не проектирую production-grade data pipelines. Бюджет большой (≈$150–450), но объём работы здесь соответствует full-stack разработчику, а не специалисту по автоматизации на Python.

40732380.title: Generative AI Filmmaker for Social Ads
40732380.description: AI Creative Producer / AI Filmmaker TOYO Kombucha | Delhi / About TOYO KOMBUCHA POSITIONING People spend most of their day working, rushing, achieving and keeping up. Somewhere between 9 to 5, life gets postponed. Toyo exists for what happens after work. We believe your day shouldn't end when work ends. That's when your actual life begins — the people you meet, the music you listen to, the conversations you have, the places you go, or simply the hour you spend doing absolutely nothing. Toyo is the kombucha for your 5 to 9. Not another drink telling you to be more productive, healthier, or better at optimizing yourself. A drink that tells you: Get a Life. . We are looking for an AI Creative Producer / AI Filmmaker who can take a strong creative idea and turn it into a realistic, social-first advertisement using generative AI. This is an execution-heavy role. The creative concepts, positioning and scripts will largely come from the TOYO marketing team. Your job is to figure out how to make those ideas actually look and feel real. What You'll Do 1. Turn concepts into realistic AI films Take a written creative brief/script and translate it into: Concept → storyboard → shots → AI generation → editing → sound → final film You should be comfortable working with tools such as: ● Higgsfield ● Veo ● Kling ● Runway ● Seedance ● Midjourney / image-generation tools ● ElevenLabs or equivalent voice tools ● Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut / equivalent editing software You do NOT need to use every tool listed above. We care about the final output, not the tool stack. 2. Create photorealistic humans and environments You should be able to create AI footage that feels like real commercial/UGC footage, rather than obvious AI animation. This includes: ● Natural human movement ● Realistic facial expressions ● Indian characters and environments ● Realistic lighting ● Natural camera movement ● Consistent characters across shots ● Realistic product interaction 3. Integrate real products into AI-generated environments TOYO is a beverage brand, so product accuracy is extremely important. You should be able to work with supplied product photographs/references and maintain: ● Correct bottle shape ● Correct label ● Correct colours ● Correct proportions ● Consistency across shots 4. Dialogue, voice & lip-sync Create believable: ● Dialogue ● Voiceovers ● Lip-sync ● Natural conversational delivery 5. Editing & sound design You will be responsible for taking generated footage and turning it into a finished social advertisement. This includes: ● Editing ● Pacing ● Transitions ● Sound effects ● Ambient sound ● Dialogue mixing ● Music where appropriate ● Captions/text ● Final export We particularly value sound design, not simply adding a trending song underneath a video. 6. Work closely with the Marketing/Creative Lead You will receive: ● Creative concept ● Script ● Brand direction ● Product assets ● References ● Desired tone You will be expected to suggest how the idea can best be executed using AI, while preserving the original creative thought. What We're NOT Looking For Please do not apply if your work is primarily: ● 3D animation ● Cartoon-style AI ● Generic AI landscapes ● AI avatars reading scripts ● Slideshows with AI images ● Template-based Reels ● Simple text-to-video experiments We are specifically looking for realistic commercial filmmaking using generative AI. Ideal Candidate You may be: ● AI Filmmaker ● Generative AI Filmmaker ● AI Creative Producer ● AI Video Producer ● Generative AI Video Creator ● AI Commercial Director ● AI Video Creative You should have: ● Strong understanding of visual storytelling ● Excellent sense of composition and cinematography ● Strong editing skills ● Understanding of sound design ● Experience creating realistic AI video ● Ability to work from a creative brief rather than needing to originate every idea ● Strong attention to detail ● Ability to iterate quickly Experience with advertising, D2C, FMCG, food/beverage
40732380.decision: Проект требует создания реалистичных AI-фильмов для социальной рекламы с использованием специализированных видео-генераторов (Runway, Kling, Veo и т.д.), профессионального видеомонтажа, звукодизайна и работы с визуальной составляющей. Это не входит в мой стек услуг — я разработчица Python-автоматизаций, а не AI-кинематографист или видео-продюсер. Хотя я работаю с ИИ-генерацией контента (тексты, озвучка, шортсы), этот проект требует экспертизы в видеопроизводстве, композиции, кинематографии и специальных видео-инструментах, которыми я не владею. Мой профиль — автоматизация бизнес-процессов, а не creative production.

40732351.title: Roofing Leads via Ads & Automation
40732351.description: I need a predictable flow of qualified roofing leads and a system that follows up automatically until they book an appointment. The plan is to split my ad budget evenly between Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), then pipe every click-to-call, form fill, and chat into a single CRM where AI-driven texts and emails handle the first touches. Here’s what the engagement looks like: • Build and launch high-converting search, display, and social campaigns on both Google Ads and Meta Ads, complete with compelling creative, copy, keywords, negative lists, and audience targeting. • Connect all lead sources to my CRM; set up tagging, pipeline stages, and real-time notifications so nothing slips through the cracks. • Craft AI follow-up sequences (SMS, email, ringless voicemail) that nurture new inquiries for at least 14 days or until they’re scheduled on our calendar. • Implement tracking—GA4, Meta Pixel, offline conversions, and call tracking—so we can see cost per lead and booked-job ROI in one report. • Optimize weekly: pause losers, scale winners, tweak offers, and keep the automations firing correctly. Acceptance criteria: campaigns live in both ad accounts, CRM automation tested end-to-end, and a baseline report delivered after the first seven days. When you reply, focus on experience—specifically any home-service or roofing campaigns you’ve managed, the results you achieved, and the tech stack you used. Let’s create a lead engine that keeps my crews busy year-round.
40732351.decision: Заказ требует услуг вне профиля: создание и запуск рекламных кампаний в Google Ads и Meta Ads, управление бюджетом объявлений, copywriting для объявлений, создание и оптимизацию креатива, управление аудиториями и ключевыми словами, еженедельную оптимизацию кампаний. Это работа SMM-специалиста и медиа-байера, не разработчика Python-автоматизаций. Я могу только интегрировать готовые источники лидов в CRM и настроить автоматизацию follow-up, но создание и запуск самих кампаний — не мой профиль.

40732336.title: Animated AI Product Launch Ad
40732336.description: A new retail product is about to hit the shelves and I want to unveil it with a short, punchy AI-generated animation that instantly communicates its benefits and sparks excitement. The ad will sit on social channels and point-of-sale screens, so it must be clear, memorable, and sized correctly for multiple aspect ratios. Scope • Concept: transform my brief product notes into a concise storyline built for promotion, not general brand awareness. • Production: use AI-driven tools (Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion, or your proven stack) to create a fully animated spot—no live-action or mixed media. • Variations: deliver one master cut (≈30 s) plus trimmed 15 s and 6 s versions for reels and bumper ads. • Output specs: 1920×1080 and 1080×1920, H.264, ready to publish. • Extras: clean background music, light SFX, and on-screen text captions. Voice-over is optional; if included, synthetic voices are fine as long as they sound natural. Acceptance criteria 1. Animation clearly showcases the product within the first three seconds. 2. Call-to-action appears in every length. 3. No trademark or stock watermarks present. 4. Final files pass a quick ad review upload test on Meta Ads Manager. Please factor two feedback rounds into the timeline so we can fine-tune pacing and visuals before sign-off.
40732336.decision: Основной результат — анимированное видео с AI-генерацией визуальных эффектов (Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion). Это выходит за рамки моих услуг. Я делаю шортсы с озвучкой и субтитрами (текст + звук + простой монтаж), но не создаю сложную 3D/2D анимацию продуктов и визуальные эффекты в специализированных видеоинструментах. Заказчику нужен видеопродюсер с опытом в motion graphics и AI-видео, а не разработчик Python-автоматизаций.

40732215.title: AI-Powered Vehicle Classifieds
40732215.description: I’m building a full-featured classified ads site dedicated to Cars, Motorcycles and Trucks, and I want it to feel as smart and effortless as the best modern marketplaces. Core platform • Front-end and back-end from scratch (responsive web, clean UI/UX). • Seller dashboard for posting and managing listings, buyer accounts with saved searches and alerts. • Secure payments integration for premium ad placements and spotlight features. • Multilingual architecture ready for future language packs. Essential AI layer The must-haves are: 1. Chatbot for instant user assistance—answer FAQs, guide ad creation, help buyers find matches. 2. Recommendation engine that learns from browsing behaviour to surface the most relevant vehicles. 3. Image recognition that auto-detects make/model/body type when photos are uploaded, speeding up ad creation and improving search accuracy. Additional smart touches I’d like included: • Voice-to-text so sellers can dictate ad descriptions. • AI content generation to polish listings and suggest optimal headlines. • AI-driven SEO tuning (schema markup, keyword suggestions, meta tags). • Automated image/video moderation to block inappropriate content. Tech stack is flexible; I’m comfortable with a modern JS framework (React, Vue or Next) paired with a robust back-end (Laravel, Node, Django or similar) as long as it scales. If you prefer a different stack, let me know your rationale. Deliverables • Fully deployed website on my cloud account (AWS or DigitalOcean). • Source code in Git with clear commits and README. • Short admin guide covering AI model training/setup, third-party keys and routine maintenance. • Two rounds of post-launch tweaks (bug fixes or minor UX refinements). Acceptance criteria The chatbot answers at least 80% of the predefined FAQ set correctly. Image recognition identifies vehicle category with 90% accuracy in testing. Recommendation engine lifts click-through rate on suggested listings by at least 15% after two weeks’ live data. Timelines are negotiable, but please outline a realistic milestone plan when you bid. Looking forward to working together on something innovative and genuinely useful for vehicle enthusiasts.
40732215.decision: Проект требует разработку полного веб-сайта с фронтенд и бэкенд с нуля, дизайном интерфейса, системой платежей и развертыванием на облаке. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг — я делаю Python-автоматизации и боты, а не веб-приложения. Кроме того, объём работы (многоязычная архитектура, 10+ функций ИИ, база данных, админ-панель, развертывание) несоизмерим с моей моделью работы одного разработчика, работающего на проектах под ключ до $180. Это требует команду и недели разработки.

40732171.title: AI-Powered Web App Development
40732171.description: I would like to launch a full-featured web application that relies on artificial intelligence at its core. At this stage the concept is open-ended: I have the general vision of an online service that delivers real-time, intelligent functionality to users, but I still need help refining the exact use case, selecting the most suitable AI model, and shaping the final product roadmap. Here is what I expect from you: • A short discovery phase where we clarify the problem the app will solve and the AI technique that best fits—whether that ends up being computer-vision, NLP, behavioral prediction, or another approach you recommend. • Guidance on dataset strategy. I do not currently have a prepared dataset, so I will rely on your advice for sourcing, cleaning, or augmenting data to train the model legally and ethically. • End-to-end development: model training or fine-tuning, integration with a modern back-end (Python/FastAPI, Node.js, or similar), and a responsive front-end (React, Vue, or comparable) that showcases the AI capability in an intuitive way. • Cloud deployment, CI/CD pipeline, and concise technical documentation so the app can be maintained or scaled after hand-off. Deliverables will be accepted when the web application is (1) accessible on a public staging URL, (2) demonstrates the agreed AI functionality on live data, and (3) includes all source code, a runnable Docker or similar environment file, and clear setup instructions. If you have a portfolio of previous AI-driven web products, share links or demos so I can get a feel for your style. I’m aiming to move quickly once we lock the scope, so please outline your proposed tech stack, timeline, and milestones in your reply.
40732171.decision: Проект требует полноценную веб-разработку с фронтенд-частью (React/Vue), облачное развёртывание, CI/CD и полный цикл машинного обучения с подготовкой датасета. Это выходит за границы моих услуг: я делаю Python-автоматизации и ИИ-агентов, но не строю веб-приложения с интерфейсом, не работаю с ML-моделями и облачной инфраструктурой. Бюджет ($30–250) и масштаб проекта также несоразмерны с этим типом работы.

40732447.title: Modern CRM Frontend Development
40732447.description: We need a modern CRM frontend for our system, inspired by HubSpot’s UI/UX. The application should closely replicate HubSpot’s screen structure, navigation patterns, dashboard layout, tables, forms, filters, sidebars, modals, and overall user experience. The frontend should be developed using React.js or Next.js with a clean, scalable, component-based architecture. It must be fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. The system should include reusable components such as the main sidebar, top navigation, dashboards, CRM tables, contact and company management screens, deal pipelines, task/activity views, search, filters, forms, dropdowns, notifications, settings, and profile menus. The objective is to achieve a high-quality HubSpot-style CRM experience, while using our own branding, colors, content, and product identity rather than directly copying proprietary HubSpot assets. Preferred Technology: Next.js / React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, reusable UI component architecture, responsive layouts, API-ready frontend structure, role-based navigation, and clean production-quality code. URL: https://www.hubspot.com/
40732447.decision: Проект требует разработки frontend-приложения на React/Next.js с дизайном и UI/UX. Это веб-приложение, которое не входит в мой профиль услуг — я специализируюсь на Python-автоматизациях, ботах и интеграциях, а не на разработке фронтенда или веб-приложений.

40732975.title: END-TO-END FID AUTOMATION + WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT
40732975.description: I run Smiling Money School, a financial education business focused on helping people work toward their Financial Independence Day (FID) and better financial preparedness for expected and unexpected life events. EXISTING WEBSITE / DOMAIN: money4smiling.com I need an experienced freelancer to develop and integrate my complete FID lead-to-customer automation system. CUSTOMER JOURNEY: Facebook / Instagram Ads → FID Landing Page on money4smiling.com → FID Registration Form → n8n Webhook → Google Sheets / CRM → WhatsApp Business/API Confirmation → FID Group Session (Zoom/Google Meet) → Automated Reminders → Attendance Tracking → 1-to-1 Calendar Booking → Financial Consultation → Payment → Automated Follow-up REQUIRED WORK: 1. Develop/integrate the FID landing page on my existing website. 2. Create/connect the FID registration form. 3. Capture lead name, email and phone number. 4. Send form data automatically to n8n through webhook. 5. Store leads automatically in Google Sheets or CRM without duplicate records. 6. Integrate WhatsApp Business/API for confirmation and reminders. 7. Integrate Zoom or Google Meet for the FID group session. 8. Automate session reminders and attendance tracking. 9. Integrate calendar booking for 1-to-1 financial sessions. 10. Prevent double booking and respect my existing calendar availability. 11. Connect payment/follow-up automation where required. 12. Provide complete n8n workflows and documentation. 13. All integrations must be configured inside my own accounts. IMPORTANT EXPECTATIONS: - No unnecessary manual data transfer. - Lead data should reach Google Sheets/CRM automatically. - WhatsApp automation should reliably trigger when the required API, template and consent conditions are satisfied. - Failed automation/message events should have proper error handling and logging. - The system must be secure and maintainable. - I must have access to all workflows, integrations and accounts. - The freelancer must explain the complete system after development. TESTING / COMPLETION: The project will be considered complete when a test lead can successfully run through the agreed workflow: Landing page → Registration → n8n → Google Sheets/CRM → WhatsApp → FID Group Session → 1-to-1 Booking → Payment/Follow-up. The freelancer should have practical experience with n8n, webhooks, WhatsApp Business/API, Google Sheets, CRM integrations, WordPress/website development, calendar automation and Zoom/Google Meet. Please mention your relevant experience and examples of similar automation projects in your proposal.
40732975.decision: Проект требует разработки и интеграции сайта (website development), что прямо указано в названии и в пункте 1 задачи ('Develop/integrate the FID landing page on my existing website'). Разработка сайтов и дизайн не входят в мой профиль услуг — я работаю только с Python-автоматизациями. Кроме того, заказчик явно требует n8n-workflows ('Provide complete n8n workflows'), а я работаю на Python. Если бы задача была чистой Python-автоматизацией без веб-разработки и без обязательства использовать именно n8n, я бы взялся, но в текущем виде это не мой профиль.

40732800.title: Refine Chatbot for Hospitality Environment
40732800.description: I already have a working hospitality-focused chatbot; what I need now is an AI engineer who can fine-tune it so that it answers guest FAQs flawlessly in English. The model is in production inside a booking engine, yet its responses still feel generic and occasionally miss the subtle context of hotel terminology. Your job is to refine the underlying large-language-model (we are on GPT-4o-mini via an API) so the bot sounds more like an attentive concierge than a scripted agent. Also sometimes it starts hallucinating. which also needs to be fixed. Scope of work * Review the current prompt structure, conversation logs, and training set (≈15 k dialogue pairs). * Design and run a fine-tuning pipeline—feel free to use OpenAI fine-tuning tools, LangChain, or your preferred framework—as long as it can be reproduced in our environment (Python 3.10). * Optimise for: accuracy on policy-compliant answers, reduced hallucinations, and fast first-token latency. * Add robust fallback logic for questions falling outside scope instead of defaulting to “I’m sorry…”. * Deliver an updated model with confidence scores and a short README so my dev team can deploy it directly. Acceptance criteria 1. ≥95 % correct answer rate on our 300-question English FAQ benchmark. 2. Average response time under 1.5 s on a t3.medium test node. 3. No policy violations across 500 random adversarial prompts. If this sounds like your specialty, tell me which fine-tuning approach you prefer and a quick outline of how you would validate improvements.
40732800.decision: Заказ требует доработки существующего продакшена с высокими требованиями к качеству (95% accuracy, <1.5s latency, тестирование на 500 adversarial prompts). Это выходит за рамки услуги 'Доработка Python-скрипта' ($40, 7 дней). Клиент просит fine-tuning модели GPT-4o на 15k диалогов с валидацией на бенчмарке — это специализированный ML-проект, требующий экспертизы в fine-tuning и гарантий качества, которых нет в профиле. Бюджет 10–30 USD несопоставим с объёмом работы. Отказываемся честно.

40732668.title: "Printflow" AI-Powered Print Shop Management System
40732668.description: --- Job Title: Full-Stack Developer to Build “Printflow” – AI-Powered Print Shop Management System Project Overview: I am a non-technical business owner looking for an experienced full-stack developer to build a complete management system for a print shop. The system is called Printflow and is based on a detailed architecture PDF that I will provide to the selected freelancer. Printflow is not just a job tracker. It is three separate but connected domains: 1. Production / Sales – job lifecycle from inquiry to payment. 2. Inventory – materials, stock levels, suppliers, reserved vs consumed quantities. 3. Finance / AP – supplier invoices, payments, purchase costs. A knowledge graph links all three domains. The system includes: · Claude (or similar LLM) as a natural-language interface so the owner can ask questions like “Do we have enough material for all scheduled orders?” · Jev (TypeSafe’s fast decision model) for high-frequency, low-latency decisions such as scoring supplier document confidence and classifying inventory alerts. · A Telegram bot for the owner to interact with the system. · Paperless-ngx integration to ingest supplier invoices and delivery notes via OCR. Scope of Work: The freelancer will build the complete application in phases. I will provide the architecture PDF and API keys. The freelancer will deliver the full source code. VPS setup, GitHub repository creation, and deployment are NOT part of this job. I will handle those myself. Phase 1 – Scaffolding · Create project folder structure (api/, bot/, migrations/, tests/, etc.) · Create docker-compose.yml and .env.example · Write a README.md with setup instructions Phase 2 – Database Schema · PostgreSQL schema for all three domains · Tables for jobs, materials, inventory transactions, suppliers, purchase orders, invoices, payments · Ensure reserved and consumed are separate columns in inventory Phase 3 – Inventory Service · Backend API endpoints for materials, stock levels, reserved/consumed quantities · Logic for supplier deliveries updating inventory · Reorder level alerts Phase 4 – Production Service · Backend API for the 14-step job lifecycle (Inquiry → Paid) · Material requirements calculation · Handoff to inventory at the ORDER stage Phase 5 – Finance / AP Service · Backend API for supplier invoices, payments, purchase costs · Link invoices to purchase orders and inventory receipts Phase 6 – Knowledge Graph · Create links between jobs, materials, suppliers, and documents · Use PostgreSQL with a graph table or Neo4j (freelancer’s choice, but must be simple to maintain) Phase 7 – Claude Tool Endpoints · Expose safe read-only API endpoints that Claude can call to answer owner questions · Example: get_open_jobs, get_material_requirements, check_material_availability Phase 8 – Jev Decision Functions · Python module using TypeSafe Jev SDK · Functions: score_supplier_document_confidence, classify_inventory_alert, check_material_availability · Wire Jev into the Paperless webhook and inventory service Phase 9 – Telegram Bot · Build a Telegram bot using python-telegram-bot · Bot receives owner messages, forwards them to the backend, and returns Claude’s answers · Include commands for common queries (e.g., /stock, /jobs, /invoices) Phase 10 – Paperless-ngx Integration · Webhook handler that receives OCR’d documents from Paperless-ngx · Extract structured data (supplier, items, quantities, amounts) using an LLM or Jev · Update inventory and accounts payable accordingly Phase 11 – Testing & Documentation · Write unit and integration tests for each service · Provide clear documentation for a non-technical owner to run the system with docker compose up -d Deliverables: · Complete source code (zipped or shared via a file transfer service) · docker-compose.yml and .env.example · README.md with step-by-step instructions · DECISIONS.md listing any assumptions made · Test suite and instructions to run tests Required Skills: · Python 3.12+ and FastAPI · PostgreSQL and SQLAlche
40732668.decision: Проект требует разработки полнофункционального веб-приложения (full-stack система управления типографией с фронтенд-интерфейсом, базой данных, микросервисной архитектурой на 11 фаз). Это выходит далеко за пределы моих услуг. Я специализируюсь на Python-автоматизациях (боты, парсеры, интеграции, генерация контента), а не на разработке сложных веб-систем с архитектурой, требующей месяцы разработки и многочисленные компоненты (FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, фронтенд, Docker orchestration и т.д.). Бюджет 750–1500 CAD (~550–1100 USD) также недостаточен для такого объёма работы. Проект требует опытного full-stack разработчика, а не специалиста по автоматизации.

40732993.title: AI Ad Videos Generations
40732993.description: I’m ready to roll out a series of bold, 8–15-second ads that instantly grab attention on both TikTok and Instagram and keep our e-commerce sales funnel moving fast. Each clip is a product demonstration with a clear, punchy call-to-action that feels native to both feeds. Here’s what I need from you: • An AI-generated video (or a short batch if that streamlines production) in a high-energy, thumb-stopping style. • Clear advice on which creation app or workflow—Runway, Kapwing, VEED, Pika Labs, Adobe Firefly, or any other tool you trust—will deliver the speed and visual punch we’re after. • Delivery in vertical format, optimized for TikTok/IG placement, and ready-to-use captions or on-screen CTA. • A quick look at past work so I can gauge your aesthetic and results. If you already have automations in place for rapid SKU swaps or template-driven edits, let me know; the faster we can iterate, the better. I’ll supply product footage or stills as soon as we lock in the direction. Looking forward to seeing how your AI toolkit can turn simple assets into sales-driving micro-ads.
40732993.decision: Заказ требует создание видео с людьми (product demonstration, on-screen CTA). По профилю я не создаю картинки и видео с людьми, сгенерированные ИИ — это запрещено. Также клиент просит рекомендации по внешним инструментам (Runway, Kapwing, VEED и т.д.), а я работаю только на Python для автоматизаций. Основной deliverable — видеопродакшн, а не код/автоматизация.

40732983.title: AI/LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer – Arabic, Egyptian Arabic, Gulf Arabic & English Smart Home Model
40732983.description: Freelancer Project Message — ~1000 characters Hello, I’m looking for an experienced LLM/NLP Fine-Tuning Engineer to develop a specialized language model for MEGA Smart Home AI. The model should understand natural smart-home commands in: Egyptian Arabic Gulf Arabic English User sentences will be Arabic-only or English-only; Arabic-English code-switching is not required. The main goal is not general conversation, but Natural Language Understanding for smart-home control. The model must identify intent, device, location, action, and parameters, then generate a strict structured JSON output compatible with our MEGA OS. It must also handle ambiguous requests by asking for clarification instead of guessing, and recognize unknown/unsupported devices or commands. Required experience: SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, LLM fine-tuning, Arabic NLP/NLU, Egyptian/Gulf Arabic, dataset creation/annotation, Python, evaluation and benchmarking. Please provide: 1. Previous Arabic/Egyptian/Gulf LLM projects. 2. Recommended base model and why. 3. Fine-tuning methodology. 4. Dataset strategy and expected size. 5. Evaluation methodology and metrics. 6. Final trained model and inference/deployment files. This is intended for local/offline deployment on MEGA hardware, so model size and quantization efficiency are important.
40732983.decision: Проект требует специализированной работы по fine-tuning LLM с подготовкой датасета, обучением модели и её оптимизацией для специального оборудования. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг: я пишу Python-скрипты для автоматизации и интеграции с готовыми LLM (Claude, GPT, Gemini), но не тренирую и не дорабатываю сами модели. Заказчик ищет специалиста по ML/NLP, а не разработчика автоматизаций.

40732854.title: Diagnostic AI for Blood & Pathology
40732854.description: I am building an AI-driven application that supports medical diagnostics by reading raw blood-test and pathology reports, extracting the relevant figures, and instantly returning an easy-to-read interpretation along with evidence-based clinical suggestions. The core workflow is straightforward: a clinician (or patient) uploads a PDF, image, HL7/FHIR payload, or even a snapped photo of a report; the system recognises the data, checks each finding against reference ranges, flags abnormalities, and explains the potential implications in plain language. Where results form recognisable patterns (for example, anaemia profiles or inflammatory markers) the model should surface likely differential diagnoses and recommended next-step investigations. To get there I will need robust OCR or direct-feed parsing, a well-trained ML/NLP pipeline (TensorFlow, PyTorch or similar), and a lightweight cross-platform front-end—web first, with mobile to follow. Clinical accuracy, privacy (HIPAA / GDPR), and clear audit trails for every prediction are non-negotiable. Please send me a detailed project proposal covering architecture, data-set strategy, validation metrics, regulatory safeguards, timeline, and your past experience with comparable medical or regulated AI products. Acceptance criteria: • ≥95 % field-extraction accuracy on a blind test set of mixed-format reports • Explanation texts capped at 8th-grade reading level, with source citations • End-to-end latency under 5 seconds for a typical two-page report • Complete hand-off package: source code, model weights, and deployment scripts ready for my AWS account Looking forward to reviewing your approach and seeing how you will turn these requirements into a production-ready diagnostic assistant.
40732854.decision: Заказ требует разработку полноценного приложения с ML/NLP pipeline, обучением моделей на медицинских данных, веб-фронтенда и мобильной версии. Это выходит за рамки моих услуг (я делаю автоматизацию на Python, интеграции и боты, но не разрабатываю ML-модели с нуля, не обучаю их на датасетах и не строю фронтенд-приложения). Кроме того, проект требует глубокой медицинской экспертизы, HIPAA/GDPR-комплаенса и валидации на клинических данных — это не входит в мой профиль опыта.

40732731.title: AI-Generated Lead Ad Videos
40732731.description: I need a set of short, scroll-stopping ad videos created entirely with AI and geared toward one thing only—driving fresh leads. Each video should combine dynamic, on-brand animated graphics with a strong call-to-action that nudges viewers to click, sign up, or inquire. I’m flexible on the underlying tech—whether you lean on machine-learning models, text-to-video platforms, or computer-vision pipelines—as long as your workflow is truly AI-powered and can turn around polished, conversion-focused creatives quickly. Deliverables • 3-5 AI-generated videos (15–30 sec each) featuring custom animated graphics • Source files or project links showing the AI process used • Two rounds of tweaks for copy, colors, or pacing so we can fine-tune performance Once we’re aligned on the concept, I’ll share brand assets and buyer-persona insights. If you can pair your AI tools with savvy marketing instincts, let’s talk and start generating leads together.
40732731.decision: Заказ требует создание видео с анимированной графикой и визуальными эффектами. Профиль предусматривает только ИИ-генерацию контента (тексты, картинки без людей, озвучка, шортсы), но не включает дизайн, анимацию или создание видео с кастомной графикой. Это выходит за рамки услуг разработчицы — это не простая озвучка или шортсы, а полнофункциональное видеопроизводство с графическим дизайном, который не покрывается профилем.

40732644.title: Comprehensive AI Real Estate Sales System
40732644.description: ’m building an AI-powered real estate sales system for the Mumbai market and am looking for an AI/full-stack developer to help me build the MVP. The idea is to create an AI sales agent for real estate brokers that communicates with potential buyers primarily through WhatsApp. The AI should be able to respond instantly to enquiries, understand what the buyer is looking for (budget, location, BHK, purpose, timeline, etc.), search the broker’s actual property inventory, recommend relevant properties, answer basic questions, collect the lead’s information, and help arrange a site visit. It should also automatically follow up with interested leads and notify the broker/salesperson when a lead is qualified or ready to speak to a human. Essentially, I want to create an AI “junior salesperson” that helps brokers turn more enquiries into qualified leads and site visits rather than simply being a generic chatbot. Your role would be to help me design and build the technical side of this product from the ground up. I am open to the technology stack, but I expect the project to involve an LLM such as OpenAI, WhatsApp Business API, a property database/CRM, automation, and potentially a simple dashboard for the broker. For the first version, we want to keep things relatively simple: one broker, one WhatsApp number, and a small database of their properties, and prove that the AI can actually handle enquiries and recommend the correct properties. I’m looking for someone who has experience building AI agents, API integrations, WhatsApp bots, RAG/vector search or similar AI applications, and full-stack systems. You would be responsible for helping architect the MVP, building the AI workflow and integrations, testing it with real-world conversations, fixing issues, and potentially continuing as the technical developer as we onboard our first clients. I’m not looking to over-engineer this initially — I want to build a working product quickly, test it with real Mumbai real-estate brokers, learn from those clients, and then expand the system based on what the market actually needs.
40732644.decision: Проект покрывается моими услугами: ИИ-агент на базе LLM (Claude/GPT) + интеграция с WhatsApp Business API + парсер/поиск по базе свойств + уведомления брокеру. Это комбинация из 'ИИ-агент' ($140) + 'Интеграция API' ($120) + 'Парсер с уведомлениями' ($80). Бюджет в пределах нормы, на английском, заказчик ясно описал требования. Все в Python, никаких n8n/Make, нет харама, честный проект.
40732644.proposal: I understand you need an AI sales agent for WhatsApp that searches your property database and qualifies leads — that's a solid MVP idea. I build exactly this type of system: LLM-based agents (Claude, GPT, or Groq), WhatsApp Business API integrations, property search with vector similarity, and broker notifications via Telegram or email. For your MVP, I'd architect it as: (1) WhatsApp Business API webhook to receive messages, (2) AI agent that understands buyer criteria (budget, BHK, location, timeline), (3) RAG-style search over your property database to recommend matching listings, (4) lead capture and qualification logic, (5) notifications to the broker when a lead is qualified, and (6) follow-up automation. I build this in Python with a simple backend (no fancy UI for v1 — just APIs and Telegram/email dashboards). Timeline: 56 days for the full MVP (agent + WhatsApp + database integration + basic testing). Before we start, I need to clarify: do you have the WhatsApp Business API account and property data in a specific format (CSV, Google Sheets, database)? And should the agent also schedule site visits, or just notify the broker to follow up manually?

40732607.title: Zoho CRM Setup & Migration
40732607.description: I have a fresh Zoho CRM account that needs to be fully configured so my team can start working out of it right away. The priorities are clear: streamline lead management, design insightful custom reports, and build workflow automation that removes as much manual effort as possible. All of my existing prospect and customer data currently lives in several Excel/CSV files. I will supply those files and a simple field-mapping guide; I need you to clean the data where appropriate, import it without loss, and verify that every record, note, and custom field lands in the right place. Once the data sits safely inside Zoho, I want to see: • A logical lead pipeline with stages, assignment rules, and notification triggers • At least three role-based reports that give me real-time visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, and sales activities • Automated workflows for lead assignment, follow-up reminders, and deal stage changes, all tested end-to-end I’ll provide admin access, branding assets, and sample process documents. When you’re done, walk me through the configuration so I can maintain it, and give me a short handover document summarizing what you built and how to tweak it. If you’ve handled similar Zoho CRM implementations and data migrations from spreadsheets, I’d love to see a quick note on your approach and any relevant examples.
40732607.decision: Заказ требует полной настройки и администрирования Zoho CRM — это не входит в мой профиль услуг. Я делаю автоматизации на Python (боты, парсеры, интеграции через API, генерацию контента). Настройка самой CRM-системы, дизайн отчётов внутри платформы, конфигурация workflow в интерфейсе Zoho — это работа CRM-специалиста, а не разработчика на Python. Интеграция Zoho через API (например, синхронизация данных в Google Sheets или отправка уведомлений в Telegram) входит в мой профиль, но сам CRM-setup — нет. Это как просить веб-дизайнера настроить сервер.
